model_annotation: The image presents three donut charts comparing enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021, based on absolute values from NACE Rev. 2. The first chart, titled "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows four sectors: Industry (8%, 2.4 million), Construction (12%, 3.7 million), Trade (19%, 5.9 million), and Other Services (61%, 19.0 million). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," displays: Industry (21%, 33.0 million), Construction (9%, 13.4 million), Trade (19%, 29.5 million), and Other Services (51%, 80.2 million). The third chart, "TURNOVER," indicates: Industry (33%, 10.6 trillion), Construction (31%, 9.8 trillion), Trade (31%, 9.9 trillion), and Other Services (6%, 1.9 trillion). Each chart includes a legend at the bottom identifying the sectors with corresponding colors: Industry (gold), Construction (light blue), Trade (red), and Other Services (dark blue). The percentages and absolute values are displayed within each segment of the donut charts, and the sectors are arranged in descending order of their percentage contribution in each chart.
